speaker: Howard
text: Developed tools, we built a wall. We built the pyramids. Math, science, history, unraveling the mystery that all started with a big bang. Raj, help me out here.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Hold on. You honestly expect me to believe that social protocol dictates we break our backs helping Wallowitz move, and then he only need buy us a pizza? I'm sorry, that really is how it works. You're tricking me. Tell me the truth. What do we get?

speaker: Sheldon
text: You get to choose between a mountain bike or a PS3.

speaker: Sheldon
text: PS3, definitely PS3. Who would pick a mountain bike?

speaker: Howard
text: Enough with the guilt, Ma. We'll still see each other. I'll come over every night and have dinner with you.

speaker: Howard
text: You don't want to see your little bird leave the nest.

speaker: Ma
text: The hell you will! Little bird? You're almost thirty! It's life, for God's sake!

speaker: Howard
text: Fine, I'll stay. You happy, crazy lady? I sure as hell hope so, because you're ruining my life!

speaker: Sheldon
text: Hey, Penny, it's Leonard. Good news, you can take your head out of the oven. Guess I won't be needing this.
